name: yt2anki
description: Turn manually captioned YouTube videos into listening-recognition material for Anki Desktop.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src http://127.0.0.1:8765 https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com; frame-src https://www.youtube.com; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
